messages:
Ivy: Heads up  the classify API example in docs/reference/classify.md shows the response with \"label\" and \"confidence\" fields, but the runtime and SDKs return { \"classes\": [{\"name\":..., \"score\":...}], \"request_id\": ... }. This mismatch is causing confusion and failing our examples-lint.

Ben: Which PR/file is that?

Ivy: It's in PR #5699, docs/reference/classify.md. Current example block:
```json
{
  "label": "spam",
  "confidence": 0.97
}
```
Should be the object form used by the service:
```json
{
  "classes": [{ "name": "spam", "score": 0.97 }],
  "request_id": "req_abc123"
}
```

Priya: Yep, the OpenAPI primary example uses the old simplified shape, so generated snippets for Python/TS show client.classify() returning a dict with label/confidence in a few places. We need to update specs/openapi/classify.yaml and the MD page.

Marco: docs-bot just posted the CI fail for examples-lint this morning.

docs-bot: PR #5699  examples-lint  failed: example_response_shape mismatch in docs/reference/classify.md. See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/5699/logs

Ben: Plan: Ivy  can you open a quick PR to replace the MD example with the canonical service response and add a short migration note for users who copied the old example? Priya will update the OpenAPI example and regen snippets. I'll add a tiny test to examples-lint to assert classify responses include \"classes\" array.

Ivy: I can do the MD quickfix now. I'll add: \"Note: classify responses return a classes array with name/score; earlier docs showing label/confidence are outdated.\" Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5705

Priya: I'll patch specs/openapi/classify.yaml to set the canonical example to the classes/object shape and run the snippet generator so SDK docs match. I'll also update the Python client docstring example to unpack classes[0].

Ben: I'll add the examples-lint unit test (reject top-level label/confidence objects for POST /v1/classify) in a tiny PR. That should catch regressions.

Ivy: Local preview: MD renders with the new classes example and the migration note. Curl against staging returned the expected classes array.

docs-bot: PR #5705 opened by Ivy  examples-lint pending.

Priya: OpenAPI PR #5710 up with canonical example and regenerated snippets for Python/TS/Ruby.

Ben: Lint rule PR #5712 added. Running CI now.

docs-bot: PR #5705 merged  CI green. PRs #5710 and #5712 merged subsequently. All CI checks passed.

Marco: Great work. I'll update CHANGELOG: \"docs(classify): standardize response schema to classes array; update examples and add examples-lint check\" and close the issue.

Ivy: Marking ticket resolved in tracker. :white_check_mark:
